title: Mouse entered signal not fired while camera is moving
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproduced in 4.5-dev3, 4.5-dev2

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev3 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 5 1500X Quad-Core Processor (8 threads)

### Issue description

I have a Control with Anchors Preset set to Full Rect. This Control is inside a CanvasLayer - this might not make sense in the MRP, but in my big project I had put it inside for organizational reasons and this bug took me a long while to track down.

Bellow the Full Rect Control there is an Area2D. is if just mouse over it the Mouse Entered signal is fired. If I move the camera so that the mouse enters the area, the event is not fired. If the control is made invisible/removed/moused outside the CanvasLayer the event is fired as I would expect when moving the camera.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8e5dc9ba-0bfb-4e46-aa32-dcb9cbe8ee30

### Steps to reproduce

Open MRP, mouse over black circle, observe output from Mouse Entered event.
Move the camera using WASD/arrow keys so that mouse is over black circle -> notice no output.
Notice that making the node called "Control" invisible, removing it, or moving it outside of Canvas layer makes it so that the event is triggered when the camera is moved.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[cameratest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19931631/cameratest.zip)
